title: Parcelhub: fillers, false starts, misheard product names, a run-on sentence
proves: Fillers do not reach the sections; misheard names are corrected; facts still placed.
transcript:
Um, okay, so, uh, this is the KT for Parcelhub, the, uh, parcel tracking backend. It's used by, like, our three courier partners.

So the app, the app runs on Amazon EKS, and we store shipments in, uh, PostgreSQL on Amazon RDS. Tracking events go through Kafka, you know.

For monitoring we use data dog, and pager duty pages us when, uh, the error rate goes over two percent.

So one problem we see a lot is Kafka consumer lag after a deploy and the fix is to restart the consumer pods and that usually clears it within a few minutes but if it doesn't then you check the partition count first

Um, never drop the shipments topic, because the partners replay from it.

Deployments are done with Argo CD, uh, every Wednesday. And rollback is just an Argo CD rollback to the last sync.

The logistics team owns the service. Escalate to Dana Whitfield if it's down for more than ten minutes.

RTO is, uh, two hours. Yeah, two hours.

facts.quote: Kafka consumer lag after a deploy
The logistics team owns the service
